_comment: PROPOSED replacement for .claude/settings.local.json. Two changes: (1) broaden the brittle exact-match rules into patterns so you stop getting a fresh prompt for every new commit message / node command; (2) this file should be GITIGNORED, not committed — it is local-machine state and the old one even hardcoded C:/Users/nechi paths. Review, then copy the 'permissions' block over your real settings.local.json and add settings.local.json to .gitignore.
